_comment: Known Salesforce orgs, keyed by Organization.Id. Ships empty on purpose: an unpopulated registry makes every alias unresolvable, and preflight.py fails closed on an unresolvable --expect. Populate it and aliases start working; until then pass the full 00D... org id. `kind` must be exactly 'production' or 'sandbox'. If the registry and the live org disagree about kind, the org wins and the gate refuses until the registry is corrected.
